text: Fern - 2nd interview @ council planning dept Thurs at 10am. v nervous, said 1st one was a car crash. text her gd luck weds night
Sadia knee op moved to Nov 4th, 8am check in @ St Mary's. her husband Emil driving her. crutches for 6 wks apparently
Yaw back from Ghana - flight was 11hrs w/ a stopover in Lisbon. mum's 70th out there was huge
call Ryan re: his dad - came out of hospital Sun, still v weak
Amy + Joseph off to Japan 3/28 for 2 wks, Tokyo then Kyoto. she wants a decent travel pillow, hint hint
dentist Tues 2:15. pick up prescription after + return the parcel
Sunil applied for the senior analyst role @ Barclays. hears back end of month. hates his current manager
Elena's mum had a fall, broken wrist. surgery tomorrow morning. Elena not sleeping. check in w/ her Fri
Elijah - final round w/ Deliveroo Oct 30 at 2pm, panel of 4. prepping a case study. ask how it went
Adriana's brother Tomás moving to Toronto in Jan. she's gutted
Sean (Seany) - hernia op went fine, home already. off work 2 wks, bored out of his mind. pop round w/ beers once he's allowed

Ruby flying to Sydney Dec 12th, 23hrs total via Dubai, landing the 14th at 6am their time. terrified of flying - last time she had a panic attack on the runway at Gatwick. going for 5 wks to see her sister Elena + the new baby. her mum's going too but on a later flight. get her some of those sleep drops + a decent eye mask before she goes?

Asha didn't get the BBC job. 3rd rejection this yr, got to final round every time. feedback was 'lacked broadcast experience' which she says is a catch-22. v down about it, talking about retraining as a teacher. her partner Bruno thinks she should go freelance. need to take her for coffee next wk, maybe Tues after work
Bruno - Lisbon trip cancelled, work wouldn't sign off leave. going in spring instead maybe
Connor's wife Katarzyna due Feb 9. scan last wk all good. he's doing paternity from the 1st
Luca vegan now. also into bouldering, goes 3x a wk
Rory - colonoscopy results Monday at 11. wouldn't say much but clearly worried. don't forget to text him Mon pm
Suzanne retiring from the hospital after 32 yrs - leaving do Nov 14th @ the Crown, 7pm. chip in for card + gift
Wei interviewing @ Google London 11/6, onsite all day. 5 rounds!! he's weirdly calm
Yusuf + his gf Mai back from Morocco. Marrakech then desert camp. she got food poisoning day 2, fine now

Jorge - cataract surgery left eye Wed. can't drive for a wk, I'm taking him to the follow up Thurs 9:30. right eye next spring if this one goes ok. he's more worried about missing his allotment than the op tbh. drops 4x a day, his daughter Mai setting reminders on his phone
Svetlana got the job!! starts @ the museum Jan 6. congrats msg tonight
Tendai's dad in ICU after a stroke, flew out to Harare last night. message her, no pressure to reply
Delroy - 5 a side Thurs. knee still dodgy from the summer
Efua thinking of applying for the head of year post. deadline 11/22. asked me to read her cover letter - do this wkend
Vikram + Asha's anniversary trip to Amalfi June 3rd-10th. 10 yrs married
passport renewal - book appt, current one expires April 2nd
Mai's cat Biscuit had surgery on his jaw, $$$. she's been off work looking after him
Fern got the planning job! starts 1st Dec. she was in tears on the phone
Emil - Dr Novak says Sadia can bear weight from Nov 25ish. physio 2x wk at the clinic
Joseph's sister Ruby Baker getting married in Lake Como, Sept 2027. Joseph is best man (?) - actually MC. dreading the speech
flights to Krakow booked: dep Dec 19th at 6:40am, back the 27th. need to sort airport parking
Sunil's interview went well apparently - 2nd round Nov 3 at 4pm, video call. he's stressing re: the presentation bit. msg him that morning
Elijah's grandad passed away last Fri. funeral Weds 1pm. Elijah taking it hard, they were close
Katarzyna's mum flying in from Gdańsk on the 2nd to help w/ the baby. staying 6 wks!

Yaw - interview Monday 9am @ an architecture firm in Clerkenwell, small practice, mostly housing. been out of work since Aug when the last place folded. has to bring a portfolio + do a 20 min presentation on a past project. said money's getting tight, Tendai picking up extra shifts. ask how it goes Mon eve
Uncle Delroy has his hip replacement 12/2. Efua says he's in denial about recovery time. visit wk after w/ grapes + crossword book
Adriana - hysterectomy next month, date TBC. she's v anxious, mentioned her sister had complications. I should check in regularly. also she loves orchids, wd be nice post-op
Ryan + Amy split. holiday to Crete off obvs. he's staying at his brother Sean's for now
Tomás - leaving Accenture after 8 yrs, last day Fri the 31st. drinks @ 5:30, Fable Bar
note: ask Connor what time Katarzyna's induction is booked - think Feb 11 morning?
Bruno's daughter starts uni in Edinburgh Sept. he's driving her up. into rowing, wants to join the club
Asha's back op Dec 8th, private, 2 nights in. then 6 wks no lifting. her kids staying w/ her mum Svetlana
Luca - got into the Thailand volunteering thing, 3 months from Jan 15. leaving his job for it. bold
Wei didn't get Google. found out Tues. says he's fine but clearly gutted. remind me to send him the Monzo listing
Rory all clear!! just polyps, removed. back at work tomorrow

Svetlana's moving to Leeds for the museum job, viewing a flat Sat at noon + another Sun morning in Headingley. needs to be in by Jan 3rd at the latest. her partner Jorge staying in Bristol for now - long distance till his contract ends in the summer. she's putting a brave face on it. their dog Pepper going w/ her
Efua's son Kwame - grade 5 piano exam Nov 18 at 3:20. she's more nervous than him lol
Suzanne - Mrs B - knows everyone on ward 7. gardener, obsessed w/ dahlias. big Arsenal fan. wd love tickets for leaving gift?
Sadia asked how my interview went. it's Thurs, haven't even prepped. block out Wed eve

Elena's mum op went OK, pins in the wrist. home Sat. Elena v relieved but knackered - she's been at the hospital every day since the 14th, back and forth on the bus, plus covering her shifts. said her brother Luca has been useless, hasn't visited once. I should drop round a lasagne Sun afternoon + offer to do a hospital run if they need one next wk
Delroy Murphy - neighbour @ no. 14. retired electrician, keeps pigeons. wife died 2 yrs ago
Vikram - promotion to partner confirmed! announced Monday. celebration dinner the 15th at 8, his treat. get a nice bottle of something

Mai - long call. Japan trip w/ Yusuf Mar 20th, cherry blossom season. booked a ryokan in Hakone for 2 nights. she's also mid-way through applying for a PhD @ Kyoto - interview by Zoom Dec 4 at 7am our time (!). her supervisor Dr Tanaka thinks she's a strong candidate. worried about leaving her mum, who's not been well since the summer. ask about the PhD interview after the 4th
Joseph - knee scan results 5/14? no wait he said 11/14. ring him that afternoon

Sean - his boss pushing him to apply for the team lead job. he doesn't want it, likes being hands on, but worried saying no looks bad at review time (review is Dec 9th). applications close Fri at 5. his wife Ruby says go for it. I said sleep on it. text him Thurs to see what he decided
Tendai back from Zimbabwe. dad stable, out of ICU, rehab place now. she's exhausted, first day back @ work Mon. her husband Yaw has been brilliant apparently. need to send flowers this wk
Ryan - job offer from Ocado!! but wants a counter. deadline tomorrow at noon. also sounds like he's finally over Amy
groceries, gym, call bank re: card. nothing else today

Sunil Patel, Elena's cousin - just moved here from Leicester. works in fintech, into cricket + board games. Elena wants me to invite him to quiz night on the 29th. also he's coeliac so not the pizza place. honestly seemed lovely, bit shy. he mentioned his mum's having her gallbladder out Nov 10th in Leicester and he's going back for the week to help - he'd booked the 8:15 train Sunday the 9th. ask how she's doing when he's back
